newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU jobless steady at 10.9 percent in November.
newsitem.headline: EU jobless steady at 10.9 percent in November.

text.p: Some 18.2 million people, or 10.9 percent of the workforce, were unemployed in the 15-nation European Union in November, a figure unchanged in eight months, the EU statistics office Eurostat said Friday.

Eurostat said the largest falls in jobless rates during the year to November were in Britain (8.6 percent to 7.5 percent), Denmark (6.6 to 5.5), Finland (16.2 to 15.3), Belgium (10 to 9.5) and Ireland (12.4 to 11.9).
During the same period, rates rose in Germany from 8.5 to 9.3 percent and in France from 11.8 to 12.5 percent.
Luxembourg's 3.3 percent rate and Austria's 4 percent pegged the lower end of the EU league table in November while Spain's stood at 22.3 percent and Finland's at 15.3 percent.
Eurostat gave no November figure for Greece, Italy or the Netherlands.
U.S. unemployment amounted to 5.4 percent during the same month.
